why_this_matters: Day 195 sits in Phase 10 (Machine Learning), whose goal is: Train, tune, evaluate and explain supervised models from first principles. Today's core material - K-fold, stratified, grouped and time-series CV, GridSearchCV and RandomizedSearchCV, Halving search and nested CV - is the vocabulary the rest of the phase is built on. Learners who skip the concept and jump to copying code usually stall two weeks later; the goal here is that you can explain what you did, not just that it ran.

code.code:
# import libraries
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
# train test split the data
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.preprocessing import LabelEncoder

# import regression algorithms
from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression
from sklearn.svm import SVR
from sklearn.tree import DecisionTreeRegressor
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestRegressor
from sklearn.neighbors import KNeighborsRegressor
from sklearn.ensemble import GradientBoostingRegressor
from xgboost import XGBRegressor
from sklearn.metrics import mean_squared_error, mean_absolute_error, r2_score

#import grid search cv for cross validation
from sklearn.model_selection import GridSearchCV

# import preprocessors
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler, MinMaxScaler
from sklearn.compose import ColumnTransformer
from sklearn.pipeline import Pipeline

common_mistakes.mistake: Watching the lecture without running the repository notebook.
common_mistakes.why: Recognition is not recall: code that looked obvious fails the moment you type it yourself.
common_mistakes.fix: For every topic today, run the linked notebook cell, then retype it from memory in your own file.

common_mistakes.mistake: Using K-fold, stratified, grouped and time-series CV on data whose types or shape you have not printed.
common_mistakes.why: Most failures in this topic are input problems (dtype, shape, missing values) rather than logic errors.
common_mistakes.fix: Print type and shape immediately before the operation; keep that habit for all 275 days.

debugging.symptom: The linked notebook cell raises ModuleNotFoundError or ImportError.
debugging.cause: Wrong kernel/environment selected, or the library is not installed in the active environment.
debugging.fix: Print sys.executable in the notebook and install into that environment (Day 4).

debugging.symptom: Your output differs from the recording even though the code looks identical.
debugging.cause: Library version differences, a changed default argument, or unseeded randomness.
debugging.fix: Pin versions (requirements.txt), set a random seed, and compare dtypes and shapes, not just values (Day 5).
